title: LEAP-2017 GWU Laboratory Tests
modifications: The TSV bytes are unchanged; selected CSV adds source line and pore pressure calculations; app embeds the actual first 2521 records (0 to 42 min) and offers eight original record selections. No interpolation, digitization, synthetic response, or correction of measurement offsets.
reference: El Ghoraiby, Park and Manzari (2020), Physical and Mechanical Properties of Ottawa F65 Sand, doi:10.1007/978-3-030-22818-7_3, §§3.3.1 and 3.3.3 and Table 3.10; Manzari et al. (2020), doi:10.1007/978-3-030-22818-7_8 §8.2.1 and Table 8.1.
porePressureRatioDefinition: u=sigma_3_kPa-sigmaP_3_kPa; deltaU=u-u(first row); ru=deltaU/99.74. The app does not substitute the source plotting script mean-effective-stress reduction ratio for this definition.
